_comment: The discovery-sync ledger (rc.29). The Loom discovery machinery exists TWICE: here as the generic harness, and in openfinance-os/ofbo as the instantiation this was extracted FROM on 2026-07-17. CLAUDE.md has carried a standing note that the two must be kept in step, with nothing mechanical behind it — the adoption dry-run proves the tree still WORKS, never that it still MATCHES. This file is the sync point and scripts/discovery-sync-check.mjs holds it to it. THREE DIGESTS PER FILE, and the distinction is the whole design. `base` is the last content the two sides are KNOWN to have shared — seeded from the extraction commit, which is a fact this repository's history can prove, not a guess about ofbo. `bundle` is what the file looks like here now. `upstream` is what it looks like in ofbo, and it is null on every entry because nobody has ever run the comparison from a checkout; inventing those digests would be exactly the overstatement this method exists to refuse. `base` is the merge ancestor and moves ONLY on a real reconciliation — --record updates `bundle` alone, because moving the base without having seen the other side would silently erase the debt it is meant to book. WHAT THIS ASSERTS: a change here that is not declared fails the build. WHAT IT DOES NOT ASSERT: that the two trees agree. `at-extraction` means byte-identical to what was extracted, which says nothing about whether ofbo has moved since. BUNDLE-ONLY: never installed into an adopting repo — provenance for this bundle, a peer of copy-manifest.json and upgrade-notes.json.

upstream.direction: This repository is canonical for the GENERIC harness: hardening lands here and is ported out to ofbo, whose own instantiation (CBUAE register, OFBO brand profile, hard-stop checklists, Q1-Q5 workflows) stays there and is never pulled in. The long-term fix is for ofbo to ADOPT via adopt.mjs, which retires this ledger entirely: the adoption stamp already tells a local edit from an upstream update, so there would be one source and nothing to reconcile by hand.
upstream.note: NEVER RECONCILED. The states below are computed from THIS repository's history alone. Run `node scripts/discovery-sync-check.mjs --upstream <ofbo-checkout>` from a session that can reach both repositories; only that can fill in `upstream`, move `base`, or set state `reconciled`.
